review_candidates.description: Requisition ID: 101848 Job Category: Infrastructure Location: Jakarta, JK, Indonesia Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining , energy , and infrastructure , our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you. About The Role Our Bridge and Civil Structures team is seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Drafter to support the delivery of major infrastructure projects across Australia and the Asia-Pacific region. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to the design and documentation of a diverse range of infrastructure assets, including bridges, retaining walls, culverts, tunnels, gantries, and other civil structures. The successful candidate will be responsible for the preparation, coordination, and quality assurance of engineering drawings and BIM models while supporting the efficient delivery of multidisciplinary infrastructure projects. The role will also involve mentoring drafters, maintaining drafting standards, and ensuring project documentation complies with client and project requirements. Key Responsibilities Prepare and coordinate high-quality engineering drawings for bridge and civil infrastructure projects. Develop detailed 2D drawings and 3D models for structural and civil infrastructure works. Produce concept, preliminary, detailed design, and construction documentation packages. Coordinate drafting activities and manage deliverables to meet project schedules and milestones. Review drawings and models to ensure compliance with project requirements, drafting standards, and quality procedures. Support engineers and project managers through preparation of engineering sketches, layouts, and design visualisations. Maintain drawing registers, document control systems, and project records in accordance with company and client requirements. Manage drawing revisions, submissions, and transmittals throughout the project lifecycle. Contribute to the development and implementation of drafting standards, templates, and quality assurance processes. Coordinate project models and drawing production within BIM environments where applicable. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior drafters and designers. Assist in project setup, BIM coordination, and model management activities. Preferred Candidate Profile Applicants should possess the following attributes and experience: Essential Diploma, Advanced Diploma, or Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Drafting, Design Technology, or related discipline. Minimum 10 years' experience in drafting and modelling for infrastructure projects. Demonstrated experience in the drafting and detailing of: Bridges Retaining walls Culverts Tunnel and underground structures Gantry structures Civil infrastructure structures Other transportation infrastructure assets Extensive experience using AutoCAD for engineering documentation. Strong capability in both: 2D drafting and detailing 3D modelling and set-out development Hands-on drafting experience with the ability to independently prepare and coordinate drawing packages. Strong understanding of document control processes, project filing systems, drawing registers, and revision management. Experience managing drawing quality, consistency, and compliance with project standards. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Highly Regarded Experience working on offshore delivery projects supporting international design teams. Experience delivering Australian infrastructure projects, not essential. Experience coordinating drafting teams and managing drawing production for major infrastructure projects. Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining drafting standards and quality systems. Experience with BIM workflows and digital engineering environments. Experience in: Revit (highly regarded) Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 Common Data Environment (CDE) platforms Experience setting up BIM projects, model structures, collaboration environments, and project templates. Exposure to multidisciplinary coordination involving structural, civil, geotechnical, and rail infrastructure projects. Why join us? review_candidates.title: E-commerce Creative Designer (Fully Remote)
review_candidates.description: E-commerce Creative Designer   DESIGN · E-COMMERCE · SOCIAL · AI   40 hours · Fully remote within Spain or Portugal · Mid-level   Help shape how Cat Elite looks   Cats deserve comfort. Their owners deserve less hassle. That's what we work on every day at Cat Elite. Our products, from drinking fountains and automatic feeders to self-cleaning litter boxes, make life easier, cleaner and more comfortable for cats and their owners.  We've grown fast through marketplaces like Bol.com and Amazon, and we're now building Cat Elite into a stronger D2C brand. Today we sell in the Netherlands and Belgium, with the ambition to grow Cat Elite into one of Europe’s leading brands for smart cat care over the next five years. At the end of 2026 we plan to start selling in France and/or Germany.   As the brand grows, the creative side needs to grow with it. How we show up on our webshop, in campaigns and on social shapes how people discover, understand and trust Cat Elite. There’s plenty of room to raise the bar, and you'll play a big part in that.  That's where you come in.  As our E-commerce Creative Designer, you'll shape how Cat Elite looks and feels across the customer journey, bring your own ideas, and use modern tools (including AI) as part of your creative process.  Why this role?   It's a new creative role with plenty of room to make it your own.   •  Shape a growing brand.  Your work doesn't disappear into presentations. It goes live across our webshop, campaigns and social, and helps shape how customers experience Cat Elite.  •  Bring ideas, not just execution.  We'll be clear on what we want to achieve, and you'll have room to shape how we get there creatively.  •  Stay close to what works.  You'll work directly with our Head of E-commerce and E-commerce Specialist, so ideas move quickly from concept to live, and you see what customers respond to.  What will you do?   You'll turn ideas into strong creative across our webshop, campaigns and social channels. In practice:  •   Design website and e-commerce creative: PDP and landing-page sections, campaign visuals, banners, comparisons and product and lifestyle imagery.  •   Create campaign and ad creative for Meta and other channels, from new concepts to strong static variations, and iterate based on what performs.  •   Create, plan and publish social content across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, while experimenting with new formats and ideas, especially for TikTok.  •   Create and edit short-form video for web, social and campaigns, using existing footage, UGC or AI-generated material.  •   Use modern AI image and video tools where they add value to create, adapt and explore content, while keeping quality high, products accurate and the output on brand.  As Cat Elite grows, so can this role. You can take on more creative ownership and have a bigger say in how the brand looks and feels over time.   Who are you?   You're a digital or e-commerce designer with around 3–5 years of experience. Your title might be Digital Designer, Creative Designer, E-commerce Designer, or something else. We care more about what you can create than the label on your CV.  You'll feel at home here if:   •   You have strong visual taste and solid design fundamentals. Typography, composition, hierarchy and detail matter to you.  •   You understand digital and e-commerce design, including what makes a clear, effective PDP or landing page work well on mobile.  •   You're confident with professional tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, or equivalent.  •   You already use modern AI image and video tools confidently as part of your creative toolkit.  •   You're comfortable with practical video editing: turning existing, UGC or AI-generated footage into polished short-form content.  •   You’re commercially minded, bring ideas of your own, and understand how good design can help people choose and buy with confidence.  A strong plus:  UX/UI experience, especially for PDPs, landing pages or other e-commerce interfaces.  Also useful:  email/newsletter design, motion/3D, photography, Shopify, or basic copy for headlines and captions.  How we work   We're a compact team, so how you work matters as much as what you make.   •  Take ownership.  You pick things up, understand the why, and finish what you start.  •  Learn by doing.  We try things, learn fast, and share openly what worked and what didn't.  •  Care about craft.  We take quality seriously and want to make work we're proud of, without chasing perfection.  •  Find a way forward.  When something doesn't go to plan, we look for practical solutions and keep moving.  •  Work well together.  We're remote, but we invest in collaboration, feedback and keeping the work enjoyable.  What do we offer?   •   A fully remote role, based in Spain or Portugal • A competitive salary   • Flexibility to work temporarily from another country, subject to prior agreement.  •   30 calendar days of paid annual leave per year  •  A home working allowance  •  A MacBook and AI tools   Practical   •   Hours: 40 per week  •   Location: fully remote within Spain or Portugal •   3 or 4 in person team meetups per year (either somewhere in Spain or Amsterdam), travel costs covered  •   Working language: English, professional working proficiency required   •   Start: by mutual agreement, preferably November 1st  Interested?   We'd love to see your work. Send us your CV and, most importantly, your portfolio. That's what we'll look at first. We're especially interested in digital work you created yourself: e-commerce, campaigns, product imagery, social or AI-assisted creative.

review_candidates.description: SiGeHo GmbH Die SiGeHo GmbH mit Hauptsitz in Bergheim-Glessen ist ein deutschlandweit tätiger Spezialdienstleister für Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheitsschutz, operative Einsatzunterstützung und Schulungsangebote. Seit unserer Gründung verfolgen wir das Ziel, Sicherheit, Verlässlichkeit und Verantwortung in anspruchsvollen Branchen aktiv zu gestalten – unter anderem in der Chemie-, Energie-, Industrie- und Logistikbranche. Unsere mehr als 30 festangestellten Mitarbeitenden – darunter Fachkräfte für Arbeitssicherheit, HSE-Manager, Sicherheits- und Brandposten, Freimess-Experten, SCC-zertifizierte Kräfte sowie qualifizierte Schulungsleiter – sind täglich auf bundesweiten Baustellen, Turnarounds und Infrastrukturprojekten im Einsatz. Was Uns Auszeichnet Zuverlässigkeit & Qualität: Unsere Leistungen basieren auf strukturierten Prozessen, fachlicher Exzellenz und rechtssicherer Umsetzung gemäß ArbSchG, ASiG, DGUV, BetrSichV und RAB 30. Weiterbildung & Entwicklung: Über unsere interne SiGeHo Akademie fördern wir gezielt die Fach- und Sozialkompetenz unserer Mitarbeitenden – durch Mentoring, strukturierte Onboardings, Soft-Skill-Trainings und technische Weiterbildungen. Teamkultur & Werte: Wir handeln auf Basis klarer Werte: Verlässlichkeit, Respekt, Aufrichtigkeit, Teamgeist, Professionalität und Innovationskraft. Zukunft & Technik: Wir setzen auf moderne Sicherheitslösungen – unter anderem mit VR-gestützten Schulungen, digitalem Materialmanagement, rechtssicherer Zeiterfassung und cloudbasierten Systemen. Unsere Vision Als führender Anbieter für Sicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz streben wir nach langfristigen Partnerschaften, einer exzellenten Teamkultur und der aktiven Mitgestaltung einer sicheren Arbeitswelt – heute und morgen. Wenn du Lust auf eine verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit Sinn hast, gerne Teil eines verlässlichen Teams wirst und dich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln möchtest, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Deine Aufgaben Dein Einsatzbereich: Verantwortung übernehmen – Sicherheit gestalten Als Experte für Brandschutz bei der SiGeHo GmbH übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden sicher, gesetzeskonform und effizient arbeiten – ob auf Baustellen, in Chemieparks oder bei Großprojekten in der Energiebranche. Deine Aufgaben Im Überblick Betreuung von Kundenprojekten als Brandschutzbeauftragter Erstellung und Fortschreibung von Brandschutzordnungen (A, B, C) Durchführung von Begehungen und Bewertung von Brandgefährdungen Beratung zu baulichem, technischem und organisatorischem Brandschutz Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen Abstimmung mit Kunden, Behörden und Feuerwehren Planung und Durchführung von Unterweisungen und Schulungen (z. B. Brandschutzhelfer) Kontrolle von Flucht- und Rettungswegen sowie Brandschutzeinrichtungen Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung gesetzlicher und behördlicher Anforderungen Gestalten & Verbessern Du bringst deine Erfahrung in die Weiterentwicklung von HSE-Prozessen ein und trägst dazu bei, unsere Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards weiter zu steigern. Dein Profil Fachkompetenz trifft Einsatzbereitschaft Das Solltest Du Mitbringen Du hast den Blick für Gefahren, denkst lösungsorientiert und willst aktiv dazu beitragen, dass Menschen sicher arbeiten können? Dann bringst du schon einiges mit. Was uns besonders wichtig ist: Ausbildung zum Brandschutzbeauftragten oder vergleichbare Qualifikation idealerweise Erfahrung im industriellen Umfeld (z. B.
